##### Project general facts

Pandawa Residence is a premium residential complex developed by an experienced international builder with over eighteen years of expertise in high-end properties. This exclusive project features a collection of private villas and apartments built using advanced cold-formed steel technology, offering superior seismic resistance and durability in tropical climates. The defining highlight is the proprietary artificial surfing wave, the largest of its kind in Southeast Asia, transforming the development into a global destination for surfers and ensuring year-round premium occupancy.

Residents and guests enjoy a thoughtfully designed ecosystem spanning extensive commercial and infrastructure areas. The complex features a main swimming pool with sun loungers, a children's pool, a cinema, a children's play area, a café, a restaurant, a spa salon, a fitness gym, and a yoga center. The artificial surfing wave stands as the centerpiece attraction, while round-the-clock concierge and laundry services ensure effortless daily living. Every element is crafted to enhance comfort, leisure, and active lifestyle pursuits.

Every unit at Pandawa Residence is crafted with long-term durability and tropical resilience in mind. Premium materials, advanced waterproofing systems, and precision construction standards ensure lasting quality and minimal maintenance. Villas feature open-plan kitchen and living areas, private pools, barbecue zones, and multiple bathrooms. Apartments offer open-plan living spaces with ocean views, balconies, and access to a shared cinema-style swimming pool. Comprehensive warranties and full turnkey readiness provide investors with peace of mind and immediate income potential.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the Bukit Peninsula within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in Bali's most premium area, confirmed by high demand, top beaches, and the highest concentration of luxury hotels. The Bukit is home to the majority of the island's five-star properties, including legendary names such as Bulgari, Raffles, Jumeirah, Kempinski, Four Seasons, and Ayana. Its beaches rank among the most popular in the world, hosting permanent world surfing championship events that attract global attention.

The location is distinguished by its unmatched natural beauty and strategic convenience. Just a short drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport, the area offers easy transit while maintaining privacy, calm, and silence, free from traffic congestion and noisy bar streets. The cliff-top sunsets over the Indian Ocean are spectacular and unmatched anywhere else in Bali. The surrounding landscape features vast natural expanses, creating a peaceful and serene environment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies prestige, natural beauty, and strong investment fundamentals, the Bukit Peninsula delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class beaches, luxury hospitality, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali's most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, exclusive and effortlessly inspiring.
